question: Which of the following countries hosted the inaugural FIVB Volleyball Men's World Cup?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1965, Poland.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In **1965, Poland** hosted the inaugural FIVB Volleyball Men's World Cup.
 
• **Eleven nations** were involved in the first edition of the competition.
 
 
• Ten countries were from Europe, the dominant continent in volleyball at the time.
 
 
 
• This is also known as the **"Tournament of the Continents".** 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **International Volleyball Tournaments:**

 
 
• **World Volleyball Championship:*** *

 
 
• *​*The first world volleyball championship was held in the year** 1949 in Prague.*** *
 
 
 
• Olympic Volleyball Championship: 
 
 
• Volleyball became a part of Olympic competitions in the year 1964 in Tokyo (Japan). 
 
 
 
• Asian Games Volleyball Championship:
 
 
• ​It was held in the year 1958 Tokyo (Japan).
 
 
 
• Commonwealth Volleyball Championship: 
 
 
• ​The first commonwealth volleyball championship was held at Nottingam (England) in 1981.
 
 
 
• Asian Volleyball Tournament: 
 
 
• The first Asian volleyball tournament was held in Tokyo in 1955.
